## Official example (05 §3)

### Paper Cut (`paper-cut`)

**Text-To-Image**

> Cinematic dimensional paper-cut miniature diorama, widescreen 16:9. Inside a humble rustic cottage kitchen, a small paper boy stands full-length slightly right of center, turned subtly toward the left. He has an oversized round cream paper face, simple black oval eyes, a tiny folded triangular nose, and thick tousled blond hair constructed from overlapping cut-paper shapes. His quiet, uncertain expression is mostly conveyed through his eyes and posture. A vivid scarlet-red paper scarf wraps around his neck and covers his mouth, with one long fringed end hanging down the front of his body.

> Build the entire scene from thick textured handmade paper, layered cardboard, and folded cardstock. Show visible paper grain, fibrous surfaces, torn edges, flat overlapping planes, and delicate shadows between layers. The boy wears a rough beige tunic with a ragged scalloped hem, tan paper trousers, and angular folded cream boots. His pale paper hands hang loosely at his sides. Keep his figure simple, sculptural, and slightly uneven, as though assembled by hand for a stop-motion film.

> To his left sits a large black cardboard wood-burning stove with circular knobs and its oven door lowered open toward the viewer. A squat black kettle rests on top. In the foreground at left, a thick brown cardboard dining table holds a gray paper mug and bowl, with a partial chair in front and a low round stool near the bottom center. Behind the stove are a rough shelf with containers, hanging utensils, a countertop, and a small four-pane window. Two folded paper pendant lamps glow warmly overhead.

> An open doorway fills the right background, revealing a cold gray rural landscape with bare tree branches, rough wooden fences, muddy ground, and distant hills beneath an overcast sky. Warm muted brown interior light contrasts with cool outdoor daylight; the red scarf is the strongest color accent. Soft cinematic shadows, miniature-set depth, tactile matte surfaces, subdued storybook mood. No text, logos, or border.

**Image-To-Video**

> [REFERENCE USE] Use the supplied image as the exact opening frame and reference for a three-second continuous shot. [IDENTITY / CONTINUITY] Preserve the boy's layered cream paper face, black oval eyes, folded blond hair, beige clothes, angular boots, and vivid red fringed scarf. Keep every object physically constructed from textured paper and cardboard, with stable cut edges and layered shadows. [SCENE] The boy stands beside the black stove with its oven door lowered. Maintain the table, mug, bowl, stool, kettle, two pendant lamps, shelves, window, and open doorway overlooking gray fields and bare branches. [ACTION 0-3s] The boy slowly turns his head a few degrees toward the stove, then holds still. His body, hands, scarf, and feet remain in their original positions. Use restrained, slightly stepped stop-motion movement appropriate to a paper puppet. [CAMERA] Perform a single gentle push inward, keeping the boy right of center and the stove clearly visible to his left. [LIGHT AND IMAGE] Preserve the warm brown interior, steady overhead light, cool gray daylight from outside, matte paper fibers, soft miniature shadows, and red scarf accent. [PRODUCTION SOUND] Quiet interior room tone with faint wind outside the doorway and a delicate paper rustle. No speech or music. [NEGATIVES] No cuts, added characters, stove flames, moving props, changing facial features, realistic skin, glossy plastic, rippling cardboard, scarf flutter, text, or watermark.
